recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片與切片中可見體積偏小、單核或低分葉（hypolobated）的巨核細胞，核圓且偏位；染色體核型顯示一條第 5 號染色體長臂缺失（del(5q)），且無其他異常，這些是 del(5q) 骨髓分化不良症候群的線索。
features: Megakaryocytes small to medium-sized with round, non-lobated or hypolobated, often eccentric nuclei (monolobated megakaryocytes)
Bone marrow aspirate cellular with trilineage hematopoiesis; blasts not conspicuously increased in the fields shown
Core biopsy: cellular marrow with a small hypolobated megakaryocyte (arrow) among erythroid and myeloid precursors
Peripheral blood: adequate platelets with occasional large platelets (arrows), a segmented neutrophil and a lymphocyte; red cell macrocytosis difficult to assess at this magnification
G-banded karyotype: interstitial deletion of the long arm of one chromosome 5 (red arrow), 46,XX background without other visible abnormalities
describe_en: The peripheral blood smear shows adequate platelets with occasional large forms and scattered unremarkable leukocytes; red cell size cannot be reliably judged at this magnification. The bone marrow aspirate is cellular with trilineage hematopoiesis and contains small megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei; blasts are not increased in the fields shown. The core biopsy shows a cellular marrow with similar small hypolobated megakaryocytes. The G-banded karyotype demonstrates an interstitial deletion of 5q as the sole abnormality. Findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with isolated del(5q).

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic syndrome, NOS with megakaryocytic dysplasia
ddx.vs: Dysplastic megakaryocytes in other MDS are often separated nuclear lobes or micromegakaryocytes, and distinction from MDS with del(5q) rests on cytogenetics showing isolated del(5q) with <5% blasts.
ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobated ('staghorn') nuclei, in contrast to the small monolobated forms here, and ET lacks del(5q).

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: MDS/MPN-SF3B1-T shows ring sideroblasts and large ET-like megakaryocytes rather than small hypolobated megakaryocytes, and is defined by SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia or MDS with increased blasts
ddx.vs: Cases with del(5q) plus increased blasts (or complex karyotype/TP53 multihit) are excluded from the favorable del(5q) category, so a blast count and full karyotype are required.

captions: Peripheral blood smear: adequate platelets with occasional large platelets (arrows)
Bone marrow aspirate, low power: cellular particle with trilineage hematopoiesis
Bone marrow aspirate: small megakaryocytes with round non-lobated (monolobated) nuclei
Core biopsy H&E: small hypolobated megakaryocyte (arrow)
G-banded karyotype: del(5q) as the sole abnormality (red arrow)
